medical_justification: Diagnosis should not depend on left-right orientation.
Diagnosis should not depend on image orientation.
Small rotations simulate differences in image acquisition orientation.
Mild illumination variation can occur during image acquisition.
Mild contrast variation can occur between acquisitions and devices.
Small saturation changes model acquisition variation without intentionally changing lesion identity.
Very small hue changes model minor acquisition colour variation; larger hue changes require caution because colour can be diagnostically meaningful.
